scientific_integrity: The Pauli spectrum is proven analytically and finite test values are checks only; novelty search cannot guarantee absence of earlier equivalent formulations.
scientific_limitations: Applies to ideal n-qubit exactly-two-excitation symmetric pure Dicke states, n>=4, and pure-state stabilizer moment of real Renyi index alpha>1. Asymptotics assume fixed alpha or fixed logarithmic-window parameter s; not a mixed-state, finite-sample or noise theorem.
title: Three-sector Rényi crossover in the two-excitation Dicke Pauli spectrum
